description: ODC (coverage T): THEME, SCRIPT and RESOURCE, three types that had never passed through the ODC lane. It mirrors the IScript of tests/jobs/client-js-reactive.json (module Script required by the screen in RequiredScripts) and adds the theme (IMobileTheme with BaseTheme and author CSS) and the resource (IResource). A UI Flow of its own receives the theme so as not to touch the MainFlow of the InsuranceApp, and the screen of that flow requires the script. The module image (IImage) is NOT included: see the blockers section of the report of front T.
